name: figma-texture-vector
description: Figma plugin: bake the Texture effect into real vector paths, so the result exports as SVG.

scripts.package: node build.mjs && rm -rf release && mkdir -p release/texture-to-vector && cp -R manifest.json dist README.md LICENSE release/texture-to-vector/ && cd release && zip -qr texture-to-vector-v$npm_package_version.zip texture-to-vector
